steps.label: 2326-own-hml-editor-saved-notice-confirm
command: (async()=>{if(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('itemId')!=='2089242')throw Error('Own editor only');const modal=document.querySelector('#webhwpSavedModal.show');if(!modal||document.querySelectorAll('.modal.show').length!==1)throw Error('Exact save notice required');const hidden=new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const timer=setTimeout(()=>reject(Error('Save notice close timeout')),5000);modal.addEventListener('hidden.bs.modal',()=>{clearTimeout(timer);resolve();},{once:true});});modal.querySelector('[data-alert-ok]').click();await hidden;return {closed:true,masterSaveSubmitted:false};})()
